fees.description:
Fee may be charged when reconnecting or reading your meter when you move into a property or change retailer. Includes GST. Fees
may vary.
Additional fees may apply. For more information, please visit the retailers website at agl.com.au/fees

Fee may be charged when disconnecting or reading your meter when you move out of a property or change retailer. Includes GST. Fees
may vary.
Additional fees may apply. For more information, please visit the retailers website at agl.com.au/fees

electricityContract.variation:
We may vary these prices no more than once every 6 months. We’ll publish variations via a newspaper and
our website at least 10 business days prior and give you written notice at least 5 business days prior. Other
charges may be varied with notice

incentives.eligibility: Free electricity usage up to 24kWhs/day applies from 11am-2pm every day. Daily supply and controlled load charges still apply. This rate can change with notice to you.

eligibility.information:
This offer is available to customers with a digital (smart) meter. The tariff applicable is a time of use tariff.
For further information about the terms and conditions applicable to this energy offer, please contact AGL
on 131 245 or visit agl.com.au.

electricityContract.onExpiryDescription:
Your market contract is ongoing. From time to time, AGL reviews its offers and this offer will be reviewed
with consideration to AGL's generally available market offers
